posts.title: Building in Public
posts.excerpt: A note on making the work visible while it is still becoming.
posts.content:
Today I realized that building in public is less about broadcasting a finished idea and more about leaving a trail of honest decisions.

The archive is useful because it keeps the texture: the wrong turns, the small breakthroughs, and the quiet days between them.

posts.excerpt: Why I am making a place for the ordinary days, too.
posts.content: A life is mostly made of ordinary days. I want to remember them with the same care I give to milestones.
